pr_title: Fix Cashbook Settlement for Oanda/FXCM CFD Trades
pr_body:
#### Description
- Added new `AccountCurrencyImmediateSettlementModel` class to model CFD settlement for FXCM and Oanda brokerages (the settlement model is overridden in the brokerage models).

#### Related Issue
Closes #2955 

#### Motivation and Context
With Oanda and FXCM brokerages, profits for CFD trades were accrued to the cashbook in the asset's `Quote Currency` instead of the `Account Currency`.

#### Requires Documentation Change
No.

#### How Has This Been Tested?
New and updated unit tests + live CFD trades with Oanda and FXCM.

issue_context.title: Oanda/FXCM CFD Profits Accrued in QuoteCurrency instead of AccountCurrency
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
With Oanda and FXCM brokerages, profits for CFD trades should be accrued to the cashbook in the `Account Currency`.

#### Actual Behavior
With Oanda and FXCM brokerages, profits for CFD trades are accrued to the cashbook in the asset's `Quote Currency`.

#### Potential Solution
- Define a new `AccountCurrencyImmediateSettlementModel` and use it for Oanda/FXCM cashbook updates instead of the default `ImmediateSettlementModel`.
- The new model can be returned only for the `CFD` security type by the Oanda/FXCM brokerage models in `GetSettlementModel`

#### Reproducing the Problem
With an Oanda `USD` account, open and close a position for a `CFD` with a `non-USD` quote currency (e.g. `DE30EUR`). We can observe that the profit/loss is accrued to the `EUR` cashbook entry. 

#### Checklist
- [x] I have completely filled out this template
- [x] I have confirmed that this issue exists on the current `master` branch
- [x] I have confirmed that this is not a duplicate issue by searching [issues](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/issues)
- [x] I have provided detailed steps to reproduce the issue

review_comments: I view this as pending work for issue #110 - ideally please make the `ImmediateSettlementModel` support generic account currencies.
